source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo historic annual reports mirrored on Yumpu
why_relevant: Third-party mirror of older Raiffeisen Kosovo annual reports that are no longer linked from the bank's current site — valuable for building long time series on card/ATM/POS counts back through the 2010s.

source_name: BQK — Institucionet Financiare të Licencuara (register of licensed/registered financial institutions, incl. non-bank PSPs/EMIs)
why_relevant: Authoritative and periodically re-published list (PDF per revision date) naming every licensed non-bank actor in Kosovo: IFJB (institucione financiare jobankare), payment institutions, e-money institutions, money-transfer companies and exchange offices. This is the master actor map for the whole non-bank payments cell and the seed for snowballing to each actor's own site.

source_name: BQK — Register of licensed electronic money issuers (regjistri i emetuesve të parasë elektronike, mandated by the e-money regulation)
why_relevant: The e-money regulation obliges BQK to publish a register of licensed e-money issuers and defines the reporting templates those issuers must file (volumes/values of e-money issued and redeemed). It tells the collector both who must exist in the register and what statistics exist behind it — the request handle for non-bank e-money volume data.

source_name: BQK — Rregullore B15 për autorizimin dhe qeverisjen e IP-ve dhe IPE-ve dhe regjistrimin e AISP (Regulation on authorization and governance of PI and EMI and registration of AISP)
why_relevant: 2026 regulation defining the licence categories (payment institution, e-money institution, account information service provider) that structure the whole non-bank ecosystem. Defines what each category may do and must report — necessary to classify actors correctly and to know which volume statistics are legally collected.

source_name: BQK — Rregullore për qasjen e ofruesve të shërbimeve të pagesave jo-banka në sistemet e pagesave (non-bank PSP access to payment systems)
why_relevant: Directly governs whether and how non-bank PSPs plug into the national clearing/settlement infrastructure — the structural gate that determines how much card/transfer volume can migrate away from banks. Highest-signal document for forecasting non-bank share growth.

source_name: Projektligji për shërbimet e pagesave (draft Law on Payment Services, Office of the Prime Minister)
why_relevant: The forthcoming payment-services law reshapes licence classes, open-banking access and reporting duties for non-bank providers. Legislative pipeline is the earliest leading indicator of new non-bank entrants and of new statistical series becoming public.

source_name: BQK — Seritë kohore / statistics portal (time series, incl. payment-system indicators)
why_relevant: Machine-friendlier time-series distribution point for BQK statistics; the payment-system series here give the denominator (total cards, POS, ATM, transaction counts/values) needed to compute any non-bank share.

source_name: BQK news / speeches — Deputy Governor Fusha on payment-services regulatory framework and fintech licensing
why_relevant: Regulator communications disclose counts that appear nowhere else — e.g. that four non-bank financial institutions were newly licensed in digital payments and three existing ones expanded scope. This is the running tally of non-bank market entry between register editions.

source_name: Paysera Kosova — first licensed EMI in Kosovo (company site + blog/press)
why_relevant: Holder of the first Kosovo e-money institution licence (IFJB licence no. 069, issued 08.06.2020 per press reporting). Publishes pricing, product scope (cards, payment gateway, Google/Samsung Pay) and periodically self-reported user/transaction milestones — the archetypal non-bank actor whose own statistics matter for this cell.

source_name: OneFor (OneFor Holding GmbH) — licensed non-bank financial institution in Kosovo, eWallet + Mastercard
why_relevant: Diaspora-focused digital wallet + Mastercard issuer licensed by BQK as an IFJB; a founding member of the FIKS fintech cluster. Card issuance by a non-bank is exactly the activity this cell must track, and its Albanian-language launch coverage carries product and volume claims.

source_name: Swinto (Velanis AG) — Switzerland–Kosovo remittance and payments platform
why_relevant: Non-bank remittance/payments app targeting the Swiss-Kosovar diaspora corridor, FIKS founding member. Remittance corridors are a major driver of cash-in/cash-out and card loads in Kosovo; partner announcements (Currencycloud) reveal rails and sometimes corridor volumes.

source_name: FIKS — Kosovo fintech cluster (under the German-Kosovar Business Association / OEGJK-KDWV)
why_relevant: Industry cluster whose membership roster is effectively a curated directory of Kosovo's non-bank payments and fintech actors (founding members named: Numarics, OneFor, Paysera, Swinto). Cluster events and position papers surface actor-level metrics and policy asks not published elsewhere.

source_name: Quipu GmbH (ProCredit group) — card processing and personalisation centre operating in Kosovo
why_relevant: The clearest documented non-bank card processor/personalisation centre with Kosovo operations, running issuing and acquiring on the TranzWare (Compass Plus) switch. Its press disclosures carry hard operational numbers (cards issued, ATMs, POS terminals, monthly transaction counts) — rare processor-side statistics for this market.

source_name: Payten — regional card acquiring/processing and POS services vendor (Asseco group)
why_relevant: Dominant Western-Balkans supplier of acquiring processing, POS terminal estates and ATM managed services; a likely counterparty for Kosovo banks and non-bank acquirers. Vendor case studies and regional press reveal terminal-estate sizes and merchant counts that no local actor publishes.

source_name: ecommerce4all-ks.com — Kosovo e-payment processing guidance portal
why_relevant: Donor/programme-built Kosovo e-commerce resource that explains, for the local market specifically, which gateways and acquirers merchants can actually use. Useful as a merchant-side map of who provides online acquiring in Kosovo and on what terms.

source_name: BQK — 'Paraja elektronike' consumer brochure (definitions, actor categories, sq/sr)
why_relevant: Supplies the regulator's own local-language glossary for e-money, wallets and non-bank PSPs — the exact Albanian phrasing needed to build reliable sq search queries and to match register entries to trading names.

source_name: BQK Serbian-language payment-system materials (platni sistem / platni promet)
why_relevant: BQK publishes its payment-system material and annual reports in Serbian as well; this is the Serbian-language entry point covering non-bank payment service providers and clearing volumes, and it also fixes the sr terminology (platne institucije, elektronski novac, platni promet) needed for Serbian-language discovery in this cell.

source_name: Kosovo payment-provider aggregator directories (PaymentProviders.io Kosovo, CartDNA Kosovo guide)
why_relevant: Commercial aggregators list which PSPs, gateways and alternative payment methods actually serve Kosovo merchants, including local names (e.g. KujtesaPay) not visible in regulator lists. Useful as a lead generator for the merchant-facing layer, but must be verified against the BQK register.

source_name: Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës (Kosovo Banking Association) — Anëtarët (members page)
why_relevant: Canonical member roster of Kosovo's commercial banks; each named member is itself a potential publisher of card/ATM/POS and payment statistics. The association also aggregates sector figures members do not publish individually.

source_name: Kosovo Banking Association — news/communiqués stream (komunikatat)
why_relevant: Association press releases routinely cite sector-level aggregates (cards issued, digital payment uptake, ATM/POS network) and name events where statistics are presented; useful as a snowball engine for further actors and reports.

source_name: BQK — Institucionet Financiare të Licencuara (licensed financial institutions hub)
why_relevant: Central Bank's authoritative register hub covering banks, MFIs, non-bank financial institutions, FX bureaus, insurers, intermediaries and pension funds — the definitive universe of licensed actors for Kosovo banking & payments.

source_name: BQK — 'Lista e institucioneve financiare të licencuara/regjistruara' (dated PDF list, 22.04.2026 edition)
why_relevant: Machine-harvestable dated snapshot naming every licensed bank, MFI, NBFI, e-money/payment institution, FX bureau and insurer with addresses — the single best seed file for the actor map, and versioned so entries/exits can be tracked over time.

source_name: BQK — Rreth statistikave / statistics portal
why_relevant: Regulator's own statistics landing area (monetary & financial statistics, external sector); pointer to the time-series files behind payment, card and cash indicators.

source_name: Regjistri i Kredive i Kosovës (Kosovo Credit Registry) — BQK
why_relevant: The set of institutions obliged to report to the credit registry is effectively a register of all credit-granting actors (banks, MFIs, NBFIs); BQK also publishes annual RKK volume figures (e.g. 347,699 loans reported in 2025).

source_name: ARBK Open (arbk.org) — open mirror of the Kosovo business registry
why_relevant: Third-party open mirror allowing search across registrations, owners, activities and statistics; far easier to query in bulk than the official ASP.NET registry, useful for enumerating fintech/payments-adjacent companies.

source_name: ARBK Atlas (arbk.atlas-studio.eu) — Kosovo business registry analytics platform
why_relevant: Claims 240,000+ registered companies searchable with CSV export and customizable columns — the most collection-friendly route to a bulk actor universe (filterable to financial/payments activity).

source_name: Regjistri i Pengut (Pledge Registry, ARBK)
why_relevant: Registry of security interests: the set of secured creditors reveals which banks/MFIs/leasing companies are actively lending, an indirect indicator of lender activity and a cross-check on the licensed-institution list.
